test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average runs scored by a batsman in 23 matches is 40. In the next 10 matches, the batsman scored an average of 13 runs. Find his average runs scored (rounded off to two decimals) in all the 33 matches.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Combined Average = (n₁ × A₁ + n₂ × A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

Total Runs = (23 × 40) + (10 × 13) = 920 + 130 = 1050

New Average = 1050 ÷ 33 = 31.818...

Rounding to two decimals, we get 31.82.

**∴ The correct answer is 31.82 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of first 23 matches = 40

Average of next 10 matches = 13

**Formula Used:**

Average = Total Sum ÷ Total Number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c345a17f4029262641fc1b422f83c356e4e677f612e9b2b265cdf8383e59a52.png] 

⇒ Total runs in 23 matches = 23 × 40 = 920

⇒ Total runs in next 10 matches = 10 × 13 = 130

⇒ Total runs in 33 matches = 920 + 130 = 1050

⇒ Average for 33 matches = 1050 ÷ 33

⇒ Average = 31.818181...

⇒ Average ≈ 31.82

**∴ The correct answer is 31.82 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combined Average Formula

When two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ and sizes n₁ and n₂ are combined, the new average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Deviation Method

Assume an average (say 40) and calculate the net deviation from this value: Net Deviation = 10 × (13 − 40) = −270. New Average = 40 + (−270 ÷ 33) ≈ 31.82.

Properties of Average

If each term in a set is increased or decreased by a constant value 'k', the average also increases or decreases by 'k'.</p
